summary:
# NOTES: "The Long Arm of the Mounted" by James French Dorrance (1926, Macaulay Co.)
Single book. Source: Gutenberg #73900. Dedication: "To Esther Dorrance, our beloved aunt and substitute mother." Frontispiece by Edward C. Caswell (missing).

## Characters
- **Sgt. John "Jack" Childress**, RCMP (Royal Canadian Mounted Police), "hard boiled," WWI veteran (honor ribbons), ex-Arctic patrol (5 yrs). Undercover in mufti on Fire Weed rustling case. Rides gray stallion **Silver** (silver-gray, shoulder brand). Has hound **Poison** (brindle, battle-scarred, "white man's hound"). Has .45 revolver, short-handled ax/"blazer," rope ("string"). Cover name "John Childress," ranch **Open A** (a 640-acre section bought from railroad, "V turned upside down"). Registered at Chateau Royal as from "Harve, Montana." Commissioner **Jim Maltby** (Jack's old friend) gave assignment; promised inspectorship.
- **Constable Padraic "Paddy" Mahaffy**, Irish, rubicund, rotund, graying; Childress's constable on ranch; "never-quits"; "clean as a hound's tooth" record.
- **Bernice "Flame" Gallegher**, daughter of Sam Gallegher; red/flame hair in braided coronet, freckles on nose, brown "freckle" eyes, dimple; rides cayuse (bay, lame earlier, mare); brand **Circle G**; ranch **Lazy G**/Gallegher Ranch. Posed as boy at Medicine Line; "Firecracker"/"Fireworks" nickname. Attended Montreal convent.
- **Sam Gallegher** ("Pop"), father, nearly bald, aquiline, tall lean dark, eagle-like; bad leg; clay pipe; buys gear from Eaton's catalog.
- **Ethel Andress**, young widow, Rafter A ranch (brand: half-diamond above A, "Rafter A"), raven hair, turquoise eyes, rides sorrel thoroughbred **Princess** (Strathconna) and piebald mustang "Blackandwhite." Husband **Cliff Andress** died in war. Loves horses; Strathconna Hunt Club.
- **Major Ivan MacDonald**, Ethel's uncle, pointed beard, pioneer/sportsman, Strathconna mansion on hill; "Lord Harry"; laid up with sprained knee (squeezing "Lizzie"/bucking horse).
- **Thomas Fitzrapp**, Rafter A ranch manager/master of hounds, florid, sandy mustache, scar on left cheek, Sandhurst grad, avoided war service, suitor to Ethel; rides black stallion **Canada**. Villain: is the rustling band leader; stole Canada and 30-40 two-year-olds via O'Hara; arrested.
- **Duncan "Dunc" O'Hara**, head buster/range boss Rafter A, "nursemaid" to orphan colts; Childress saved him from a lynch mob at end of steel on Trans-Continental railroad. Betrays Fitzrapp, steals Canada.
- **Season's Greetings**, half-breed wrangler, one useless eye, bristly mustache; Fitzrapp's accomplice.
- **Darned Cuss**, Rafter A hand; wife Mrs. Cuss is housekeeper.
- **Smiling Dick Murdock**, Lazy G range boss, handsome, dark; in love with Flame; forced branding plan; shot by Childress at Crow's Nest.
- **Roper** and **Rust** (Rusty), Lazy G punchers; Roper proposed branding.
- **Chan Toy**, Chinese cook at Lazy G.
- **Doc Chase**, outguard rancher at gateway to Crow's Nest; flag signal (white flag = friend; stripes = alarm); son **Tommie**.
- **Bart Crowe**, proprietor of Crow's Nest (dropped "e"); hard outlaw camp, rum runner.
- **Delores Doleroso**, dance-hall woman.
- **Sven Larsen**, Swede logger; tried to calk Childress; Childress's forearm cut by spiked boot.
- **Peg-leg** outlaw and dope-artist violinist (minor).
- Strathconna officials: race starter; warrant officer in gray derby; Dick Allen (Missoula, bought Canada).

## Places
Medicine Line (border; Childress crossed in moonlight, Chapter I); Fire Weed Country (Canadian West, Alberta-ish); Whitefoot Reservation (coyote hunt, Ch II); Strathconna (provincial metropolis; King & Prince Streets; Chateau Royal; Maple Leaf Midland Railroad land office; Victoria Park; Provincial Fair Association; Hunt Club; Winnipeg/Regina references); Soda Springs (meeting place); Rowdy River & Placid River fork (Hudson's Bay post); Witch River; Rafter A home ranch (log house, lower range, Crooked Coulee, Feather Bed Meadow, Breakfast Flat, Corn Cob Basin); Open A basin (cup of hills, canvas corral, log cabin, creek, upper pasture, side ravine); Gallegher home ranch (lake, cook-shack, bunkhouse, Friday Gulch, Punishment Gulch, bog with sinking cow, buttes, Devil's-club patch, ridge with hemlock trap); Crow's Nest (Bitter Root Mountains, Bison County sheriff, Montana); Bad lands; Medicine Line/timber belt.

## Events in order
**Ch I (Medicine Line):** Childress crosses border at night on Silver, Poison following. Bay-mounted girl (disguised as boy) flees posse of 5 Crow's Nest men who charge her with horse stealing. Childress faces posse across drawn line ("Mounties shoot last"). Bernice says "Five to two." Posse retreats. Bernice faints in his arms briefly. He calls her "Sergeant Brave but Impossible." Plans swap of horses at Soda Springs.

**Ch II (Rescue Unwelcome):** Whitefoot Reservation: Poison joins coyote chase; Childress sees runaway sorrel Princess with woman rider (Ethel). He rescues her by lifting her onto Silver. She is angry; hunt club sees. He lends Silver so she finishes first; he ropes Princess.

**Ch III (Wrong Party):** Childress catches/fixes sorrel. Meets Fitzrapp (who questions him). Ivan MacDonald introduces himself as uncle. Childress is "John Childress" from States. Hunt ends at noon. MacDonald invites Childress to ride to city. Poison kills coyote.

**Ch IV (Riding Boot Rivals):** Ethel and Fitzrapp ride home. Fitzrapp accuses Childress; suspects silver stallion = rustler's horse (silver stallion seen in storm at boundary). Ethel defends him; Fitzrapp jealous.

**Ch V (Too Much Luck):** Strathconna described. Childress visits Maple Leaf Midland Railroad land office, buys ready-made 640-acre section (Open A) with 1/20 cash. Bernice arrives to claim same section, too late; "Some folks have too much luck."

**Ch VI (Sealed Lips):** Agent introduces them. Childress promises to give her first refusal if he leaves. Bernice swears "I'll be damned if I'll step into any man's shoes." At Chateau dinner, Fitzrapp reports seeing Childress with Bernice; Ethel announces she'll ride the next raid.

**Ch VII (Last Warning):** Constable Mahaffy grumbles at unroofed cabin. Bernice rides to Open A, warns Childress to leave (Gallegher-Rafter pursuit; "eliminate" him). Threatens him not to bring horse on Gallegher land.

**Ch VIII (Threat of Doubt):** Ethel rides to bluff, sees Open A cabin and silver stallion. Fitzrapp's suspicion of Childress as rustler. Rafter A raid lost 50 head; Fitzrapp shot at (hat bullet hole). Fitzrapp proposes marriage; Ethel postpones answer.

**Ch IX (Bust 'em, Broncho):** Childress breaks roan outlaw in corral. Ethel warns him of danger; he refuses to leave. Mahaffy flees corral. Poison runs off.

**Ch X (Home of Flame):** Childress rides to Gallegher ranch, rescues cow from bog. Finds skinned steer alive; mercy-shots it. Bernice shoots buzzard. They split to hunt Indian skinner.

**Ch XI (Did He Dare?):** Childress chases skinner over border into timber; trapped on ledge 50 ft up; skinner throws ladder down. Childress fells a hemlock to cross.

**Ch XII (By Single Strand):** Childress crosses on hemlock; returns to find skinner's cayuse. Next morning Lazy G riders (Murdock/Roper/Rust?) lasso him with ropes, wind him up, take him prisoner.

**Ch XIII (In Punishment Gulch):** Murdock leads. Childress claims he's a rancher. Murdock plans branding "Lazy G" horseshoe on forehead; Childress refuses to sign confession; Murdock lights pipe, doubts. Flame arrives and frees him.

**Ch XIV (His Biggest Debt):** Flame frees Childress; invites him home. Sam Gallegher meets Ethel and Fitzrapp on porch. Joint protest letter to Commissioner (signed by Ethel-Rafter A, Flame-Circle G, Sam-Lazy G, Childress-Open A). Fitzrapp declined to sign.

**Ch XV (Trapping for Proof):** O'Hara nursemaids colts; Fitzrapp discusses O'Hara's report that Ethel visited Childress. Fitzrapp plans to trap Childress with planted horses; jealous rage.

**Ch XVI (Clean as a Hound's Tooth):** Night at Open A; Childress catches O'Hara in ravine corral with 15 two-year-olds. O'Hara reveals Fitzrapp's plot (MacDonald to raid Open A at dawn). Childress says he'll drive horses to Montana; O'Hara promises to help.

**Ch XVII (Calling a Bluff):** Fitzrapp & MacDonald raid Open A; find no horses. Fitzrapp challenges Childress to race Silver vs. Canada for $1,000 (certificate of deposit; MacDonald stakeholder); race set for Strathconna "day before exposition." MacDonald suspicious of Fitzrapp.

**Ch XVIII (Rustled to a Finish):** Fitzrapp's note: band of five crossed ford. Fitzrapp & Season's Greetings lose ~75 head, Fitzrapp's hat shot. Greetings' account. Ethel recalls day at Open A luncheon with women friend; sees Childress with Flame.

**Ch XIX (Surprises for Flame):** Silver found in Lazy G stable; Sam says Childress left Silver and rode toward Montana ("business"). Flame decides to go after him.

**Ch XX (Poor Branded Man!):** Flame meets Childress on trail, sees fake horseshoe brand (blister paste, painted). He says he's going to Crow's Nest to clear his name. She begs him not to go.

**Ch XXI (The Nest of the Crow):** Crow's Nest described; Doc Chase signals with flag. Childress posts a $1,000 "Wanted" poster for himself; signs horseshoe on it. Dance-hall incident with Delores; Sven Larsen fight.

**Ch XXII (Threat of Spikes):** Childress nearly calked by Larsen; protects face with arm (forearm cut). Realizes he loves Flame. Accepted as outlaw; Crowe makes him guest.

**Ch XXIII (Coming a Cropper):** Ethel & MacDonald in Strathconna; return to ranch. Fitzrapp reports arm sprain; O'Hara betrayed him, stole Canada and 30-40 two-year-olds. Fitzrapp shows Childress's red notebook as evidence. MacDonald plans warrant for Childress; race expected.

**Ch XXIV (Out of the Nest):** Childress at Crow's Nest. Murdock arrives; Flame arrives at Crow's Nest. Murdock tries to take Flame; Childress shoots Murdock. Escape with Flame through window; shot through shoulder. Childress tells Flame he loves her. Escape on Silver (second horse) into night.

**Ch XXV (Grip of the Law):** Race day at Strathconna track. Childress arrives in RCMP uniform with Mahaffy; Canada brought out by Mahaffy. Fitzrapp arrested for horse stealing; confesses; sold Canada to Dick Allen of Missoula (Childress bought it from Allen). Childress reveals "Mrs. John Childress" — Flame married him. Flame: "We need him down on the range." Childress plans to resign from service and ranch in Fire Weed. Ends: "THE END."
